jobs.title: PNT Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**: IS4S is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to support the development of embedded software for Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems working on-site in our Auburn, AL or Huntsville, AL location. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of navigation algorithms, sensor interfaces, platform integration, and software testing for resilient navigation solutions operating in challenging environments, including conditions where GPS/GNSS may be degraded, denied, or unavailable.

This role offers the opportunity to work across the embedded software development lifecycle, from algorithm implementation and hardware interfacing to integration, testing, and performance evaluation. The ideal candidate has strong modern C++ programming skills, experience developing software in Linux environments, and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Develop and maintain embedded software components for assured PNT systems using modern C++.

Implement and support navigation algorithms that process data from inertial sensors, GPS/GNSS receivers, clocks, and other navigation sources.

Develop and maintain software interfaces to sensors, embedded hardware, and host platforms.

Integrate software components with navigation hardware and platform systems, troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues.

Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests to verify software functionality and performance.

Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization.

Use Git-based version control, automated build systems, and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality and repeatable development workflows.

Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Experience developing software in modern C++, including object-oriented programming, standard library features, and sound software design practices.

Experience developing, building, debugging, and testing software in a Linux environment.

Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes.

Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well-documented software.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with embedded software development on Linux-based platforms.

Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies.

Experience interfacing with hardware using serial communications, Ethernet, SPI, I²C, CAN, or similar protocols.

Experience with unit testing frameworks and software quality tools, such as static analysis, code coverage, and automated linting.

Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD.

Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, test automation, and data analysis.

Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, embedded system integration, or field testing.

**Benefits Summary:**

Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits

Dynamic and collaborative work environment

Employee ownership

Medical, dental, and vision care plans

Paid time-off and parental leave programs

Group term life insurance

401(k) retirement plan

Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Verustruct is developing a suite of robotic construction technologies to automate the building of affordable, sustainable, safe, and aesthetically appealing housing. The company’s mission is to help close the U.S. housing gap of 4.5 million homes by transforming how residential structures are designed and built. Verustruct focuses on integrating advanced robotics, automation, and novel construction methods into practical, scalable solutions. Team members collaborate across disciplines to bring next-generation construction systems from concept to field deployment, with a strong emphasis on real-world impact and long-term sustainability.

**About the Role**

Build the electrical systems that turn robotic construction devices into reliable, autonomous machines.

Verustruct is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer to own electrical architecture and subsystem development for our robotic construction platform. You will take systems from requirements and circuit design through board bring-up, embedded integration, machine testing, and field deployment.

Our robots combine motors, actuators, sensors, embedded controllers, and construction processes in a demanding physical environment. You will make those systems operate predictably together, with particular attention to power integrity, communications, fault handling, serviceability, and safe machine behavior.

This is a hands-on technical ownership role with opportunities to mentor engineers and shape the electrical team’s standards as we grow. It is full-time and on-site in Torrance, California.

**What You'll Do**

* Define electrical architectures, subsystem requirements, power budgets, and interfaces across robotic formwork, locomotion, material delivery, consolidation, and auxiliary tools.
* Own custom electronics from component selection and schematic capture through PCB layout, fabrication, assembly, bring-up, and revision.
* Develop power-distribution, motor-control, actuator-interface, and sensor-interface hardware, including appropriate protection, grounding, shielding, and thermal management.
* Write, review, and debug embedded C/C++ on STM32-class microcontrollers for sensing, actuator control, communications, diagnostics, and fault handling.
* Define and validate CAN/CAN FD network architecture, including physical topology, termination, message interfaces, bus loading, and recovery behavior.
* Design harnesses, connector interfaces, electrical enclosures, and service features for equipment exposed to vibration, dust, moisture, and electrically noisy loads.
* Partner with controls and software engineers to define timing requirements, operating states, watchdog behavior, and responses to communication or component failures.
* Develop emergency-stop, interlock, and power-isolation architectures in coordination with system safety requirements and the broader engineering team.
* Create verification plans, test fixtures, and automated tests that demonstrate electrical performance and fault response at board, subsystem, and machine levels.
* Lead electrical integration and root-cause investigation, using measured evidence to resolve intermittent and cross-disciplinary failures.
* Own electrical release documentation and design reviews, support suppliers and manufacturing partners, and mentor junior engineers.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What We're Looking For**

* Substantial electrical product-development experience, typically 7+ years, with ownership of complex electromechanical systems.
* Demonstrated delivery of custom electronics from design through working hardware and integrated system testing.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics, power conversion and distribution, motor drives, signal integrity, and circuit protection.
* Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB design using KiCad, Altium, or comparable tools.
* Practical embedded C/C++ experience and the ability to debug hardware and firmware together.
* Experience integrating motors, actuators, encoders, sensors, and communications such as CAN, SPI, I2C, and UART.
* Strong bench skills with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, electronic loads, and other electrical test equipment.
* Experience with harness design, grounding, shielding, and troubleshooting noise or power-related failures in operating machines.
* Clear technical communication, sound design-review judgment, and a willingness to work directly on prototype hardware.
* A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Benefits**
------------

Benefits include:

* **Health insurance:** Silver PPO plan, 80% company-paid, with optional dental and vision coverage
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with 4% employer match
* **Time off:** Flexible PTO policy and observed federal holidays
* **Relocation support:** Available for exceptional candidates relocating to the Los Angeles / Torrance area
* **High-ownership role:** Opportunity to help lead mechanical engineering for a venture-backed robotics company tackling housing affordability

Compensation Range: $160K - $205K

jobs.description:

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

  

NVIDIA is searching for a creative, highly motivated and independent engineer with expertise in system software with security background to join the SOC System Software organization. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting SOC based product lines ranging from autonomous vehicles, robotics, consumer graphics, and edge AI.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead all HDCP (High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection) activities across SoC-based projects, leading the feature roadmap, protocol implementation, compliance certification, and delivery across chips, platforms, and products.
* Develop and maintain secure-engine firmware on a RISC-V based secure processor.
* Deliver end to end HDCP solution across multiple software stacks spanning Linux, Android for automotive, and consumer platforms.
* Drive firmware production signing readiness, rollback-prevention strategies, and key-provisioning workflows.
* Serve as the security primary contact for the team, leading all aspects of threat modeling, static analysis, vulnerability tracking and remediation, and security compliance across all projects.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams spanning HW design, boot firmware, power management, validation, and GPU display to align on architecture and delivery.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in embedded systems, firmware, or system software development.
* Strong RISC-V or embedded processor firmware development experience with privilege-level isolation and secure boot.
* Deep understanding of cryptography and security protocols, specifically HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication, key management, and repeater topology.
* Strong familiarity of how HDCP integrates with display protocols, e.g. HDMI, DisplayPort.
Consistent record leading cross-team technical initiatives from architecture through certification and delivery.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Hands-on experience with HDCP compliance certification.
* Experience with SoC-level system integration: firewalls, fuse controllers, privilege isolation, and secure carveouts.
* Experience productizing DRM protocols (Widevine, PlayReady).
Familiarity with automotive security standards (ISO 21434, UN R155).

We're seeking talented Electrical Engineers with deep, hands-on industry experience in circuit design, power systems, or embedded hardware to bring real engineering judgment and elevate the quality of our AI training data. * Design challenging, domain-relevant tasks, and write accurate and well-structured reference solutions to electrical engineering problems.
* Evaluate electrical engineering tasks and model outputs and provide clear, written technical feedback, catching incorrect assumptions, unit and sign errors, violated design constraints, and unsafe design choices.

jobs.description:
### **Job Overview**

* The Stanford Synchrotron Radiation Lightsource (SSRL), a directorate of the Stanford Linear Accelerate (SLAC) National Laboratory has an opening for a Project Engineer with experience in controls engineering, data collection frameworks, software development and deployment. SSRL is developing and implementing controls systems software based on Python to enable real time data handling to support in-situ, operando, and ultimately autonomous experimentation at the synchrotron. In this role, you will apply your engineering and software skills to work with the world’s leading research groups developing new materials to solve global energy challenges. This position will serve to unify, implement, and test existing free open source software tools, and also to extend the functionality of existing tools and contribute them back to the community. Development will be driven by current scientific focus of SSRL with a primary focus on developing data analysis pipelines and autonomous control approaches for x-ray scattering, diffraction, absorption, and imaging problems. Objectives will include readying existing beamlines for the deployment of machine learning algorithms that will be used for autonomous data analysis and experimental steering and are expected to lead to publication of scientific research employing these tools.
  
* **Your specific responsibilities include:**
  
* + Implement modern electronics controls software like The Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS) for controlling complex instrumentation.
    
  + Deploy the next generation data collection framework “bluesky” at SSRL beamlines.
    
  + Execute all programming tasks, including programming, analyzing, designing, developing, implementing, modifying, and maintaining computer programs. Work on systems of small to moderate size and complexity or segments of larger systems.
    
  + Survey, assess, modify, and employ existing free software tools.
    
  + Develop, test, deploy, and promote cross-platform software in the public domain.
    
  + Communicate regularly and clearly with co-developers as well as experimentalists.
    
  + Publish or assist in publishing results of scientific research pertaining to the developed software packages.
    
  + Assess stakeholder needs and requirements.
    
  + Design and develop applications that may involve sophisticated data manipulation.
    
  + Maintain and update existing programs.
    
  + Troubleshoot and solve technical problems.
    
  + Create programs to meet reporting and analysis needs.
    
  + Design and implement staff training.
    
  + Document changes in software for end users.
    
  + Follow team software development methodology.
    
  + Serve as technical resource with respect to applications.
    
  + Other duties may also be assigned.
  
* **Note**: This is a 2-year fixed term position with the possibility of extension or conversion to a regular- continuing position. Assignment duration is contingent upon project needs and funding.
  
* **To be successful in this position you will bring:**  
  + Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, software engineering or related field and experience with controls engineering
    
  + Strong knowledge of at least one programming language e.g. python
    
  + Some familiarity with electronics controls systems
    
  + Experience with user experience design and implementation

  + Ability to define and solve logical problems for technical applications.
    
  + Knowledge of and ability to select, adapt, and effectively use a variety of programming methods.
    
  + Ability to recognize and recommend needed changes in user and/or operations procedures.
    
  + Basic knowledge of software engineering principles.

**In addition, preferred requirements include:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, with hands-on experience in scientific computing or data-driven research; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  
* Experience developing and deploying software packages in the public domain.
  
* Developing with scientific data acquisition frameworks (such as Bluesky) and implementing machine learning methods for data analysis or experimental steering.
  
* Awareness and enthusiasm for the impact of software tools in the scientific community.
  
* Fluency with git and related team development tools.
  
* Proficiency working in UNIX and Windows environments.
  
* Reliability, especially in regular communications with colleagues.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

At The Marzetti Company, our mission is to make every meal better through high-quality, flavorful food. The Automation & Controls Engineer is a hands-on technical resource responsible for the reliability, improvement, integration, and cybersecurity of automation systems across food processing, packaging, plant utilities, and facility infrastructure.

Working with a high degree of independence, this role supports day-to-day production, resolves complex controls issues, modernizes legacy systems, and delivers automation projects that improve safety, food quality, throughput, equipment uptime, and the operator experience. The engineer partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality and Food Safety, Continuous Improvement, Information Technology, and external OEMs and system integrators.

Technology Environment:

* **PLC and machine control:** Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation ControlLogix and CompactLogix using Studio 5000; additional platforms may include ABB, Bosch Rexroth, Mitsubishi, Omron, and Siemens.
* **Visualization and manufacturing systems:** Ignition SCADA and historian capabilities, FactoryTalk View, ThinManager, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
* **Connectivity and data:** EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, Profibus, IO-Link, Microsoft SQL Server, database interfaces, and Python scripting.
* **OT infrastructure:** Managed industrial switches, VLANs, segmented OT networks, firewall rules, Claroty xDome Secure Access for secure remote access, role-based access control, and Purdue Model/five-layer OT architecture.
* **Plant systems:** Processing and packaging equipment, robotics, servo and motion systems, VFDs, instrumentation, building management systems, and plant utility systems.

Responsibilities What You'll Do:

**Automation & Controls Engineering**

* Program, troubleshoot, maintain, and optimize PLC-based control systems, with primary emphasis on Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation ControlLogix and CompactLogix platforms using Studio 5000.
* Support and troubleshoot other controls platforms deployed within the facility, which may include ABB, Bosch Rexroth, Mitsubishi, Omron, and Siemens systems.
* Develop, maintain, and improve SCADA/HMI applications using Ignition and FactoryTalk, including tag structures, alarms, trends, historian data, reports, recipes, security roles, and operator interfaces.
* Identify and execute PLC, HMI, SCADA, historian, and controls-infrastructure improvements, upgrades, migrations, obsolescence-risk mitigation, and standardization initiatives.
* Troubleshoot VFDs, servo and motion systems, instrumentation, remote I/O, industrial robots, safety systems, and machine-to-machine communications.
* Maintain accurate controls documentation, including software backups, change records, I/O lists, control narratives, network diagrams, wiring schematics, and operating or troubleshooting procedures.

**OT Networks, Cybersecurity & System Integration**

* Partner with Information Technology and OT cybersecurity teams to support the design, documentation, implementation, and ongoing improvement of segmented OT networks aligned with the Purdue Model and a five-layer manufacturing technology stack.
* Support managed industrial Ethernet switches, VLANs, IP addressing, network paths, and device communications; partner with IT to coordinate firewall-rule changes, Claroty xDome Secure Access, and secure connectivity for internal and third-party users.
* Implement and maintain role-based access, least-privilege permissions, user groups, and account governance across PLC, SCADA, ThinManager, historian, MES, server, and network environments.
* Integrate OEM equipment, sensors, PLCs, SCADA, MES, historians, databases, and enterprise systems using EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT, serial or gateway communications, and other appropriate protocols.
* Support MQTT and edge-connectivity solutions, including broker connectivity, topic or namespace design, reliable data transfer, and plant-floor-to-enterprise integration.
* Configure and support Microsoft SQL Server connections, tables, queries, views, and data flows; develop Python scripts for data collection, diagnostics, reporting, configuration, and repetitive engineering tasks.

**Reliability, Operational Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide responsive technical support to Maintenance and Operations, taking ownership of control-system problems through containment, diagnosis, corrective action, and verified resolution.
* Lead or participate in root cause analysis for recurring failures, production losses, quality events, and communication issues; translate findings into sustainable system improvements.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve safety, reliability, throughput, OEE, product quality, waste, ergonomics, maintainability, and operator experience.
* Lead or support capital and continuous-improvement projects, including requirements development, controls specifications, vendor design reviews, FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, startup, validation, and handoff to Operations and Maintenance.
* Interface with machine builders, OEMs, system integrators, and controls vendors to define, design, implement, troubleshoot, and improve equipment and processes.
* Support automation and data integration for processing, packaging, building management, refrigeration, compressed air, steam, chilled water, process water, wastewater, electrical monitoring, and other plant utility systems.

jobs.title: Signal Integrity Systems Engineer (Entry level to Senior)
jobs.description:
**Your Job**

Molex is offering a highly visible role for a Signal Integrity Systems Engineer, and you will design leading-edge solutions for the data services industry, influence next-generation active cable platforms using innovative chips in coordination with engineers from various disciplines.

You will also work closely with our Hyperscale customers and marketing teams to understand the customer's application needs and translate them into best-in-class winning solutions. You may also spend firsthand time on Molex lab facilities and deliver innovative development solutions supporting our products and driving revenue.

**Our Team**

Molex, a subsidiary of Koch Industries, creates connectivity solutions that enable technologies to transform the future and improve lives. With operations in more than 40 countries, Molex offers connectivity products, services, and solutions for the data communications, medical, industrial, automotive, and consumer electronics industries. We do more than develop customer solutions-we create connections for life.

Molex is looking for a Signal Integrity Systems Engineer to support and develop Active cable designs for Hyperscalers. Our business is witnessing tremendous growth owing to an increasing need for Artificial Intelligence and data transfer rates. You will be working under leadership that has been setting and driving industry standards in data centers for more than 30 years.

**What You Will Do**

* Own system-level SI analysis for high-speed channels including AEC, ACC, DAC, connectors, and PCB interconnects.
* Develop and analyze end-to-end channels for 112G and 224G PAM4 applications.
* Develop and analyze S-parameter models, correlate simulation models against VNA measurements.
* Perform IBIS-AMI and statistical/electrical simulations for high-speed PAM4 channels.
* Perform system-level BER, eye, jitter, and SNR analysis and identify channel performance limitations.
* Correlate simulation, VNA, TDR, and oscilloscope measurements with system-level results.
* Troubleshoot SI issues across PCB, connector, cable, package, and silicon interfaces.
* Work closely with ASIC/PHY, hardware, PCB, connector, cable, firmware, and validation teams.
* Support customer demonstrations, interoperability testing, plugfests, and technical reviews.
* Create technical reports and present SI results to customers and internal engineering teams.
* Lead root-cause investigations and recommend design improvements.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering, or related field.
* Experience in high-speed signal integrity, channel modeling, or system validation.
* Good understanding of transmission-line theory, S-parameters, crosstalk, loss/dispersion, reflections and impedance discontinuities, jitter, BER, and equalization.
* Experience with HFSS, Keysight ADS/PLTS, Cadence Sigrity, or similar tools.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering, or related field.
* Hands-on experience with VNA, TDR/TDT, high-speed oscilloscopes, and BERTs.
* Experience working with S-parameter data and channel models.
* Experience with Python, MATLAB, or similar scripting environments for SI data analysis.
* Experience with 112G/224G PAM4 or similar high-speed SerDes.
* Experience with AEC/ACC/DAC cables and high-speed connectors.
* Experience with IBIS-AMI modeling and simulation.
* Understanding of IEEE, OIF, and/or relevant industry specifications.
* Experience with CMIS, QSFP, OSFP, or other pluggable optical/electrical interfaces.
* Experience correlating simulation models with physical measurements.
* Experience with automated SI data processing using Python.
* Strong problem-solving and cross-functional communication skills.
* Analyze Tx/Rx equalization, including CTLE, FFE, DFE, and re-timer/re-driver behavior.

This position does not qualify for VISA Sponsorship.

For this role, we anticipate paying $80,000 - $150,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. The **Resilient Connectivity Products** **(RCP) Hardware Technologies** team is seeking a driven, creative Senior Electrical/Power Engineer to help shape the future of secure, high‑speed communication systems across ground, airborne, and space platforms. In this role, you’ll directly influence mission‑critical hardware powering advanced software-defined radios, high‑bandwidth data links, and resilient communication networks operating in some of the world’s toughest environments.

You’ll join a collaborative team building state‑of‑the‑art power electronics—closed‑loop power supplies, EMI filters, high‑efficiency conversion stages—and guide designs from concept through qualification. This hands‑on role spans power conversion systems, magnetics, EMI mitigation, and PFC solutions, offering opportunities to innovate at every stage of the hardware lifecycle.

As a **Senior Electrical Engineer**, you will apply deep expertise in switching converters, magnetics, control loops, manufacturability, and testability to deliver high‑reliability aerospace hardware. **Potential Onsite Locations:**  

* Cedar Rapids, IA
* Fort Wayne, IN

* Generate engineering documentation: requirements, design descriptions, schematics, BOMs, and test plans.
* Support integration, verification, validation, and qualification testing new and existing designs.
* Partner closely with Systems, Mechanical, Software, Manufacturing and Digital Hardware teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Diagnose and solve issues related to power conversion performance, reliability, EMI/EMC, and thermal behavior.
* Ensure adherence to aerospace standards and mission assurance expectations.
* Mentor junior engineers and support a culture of technical excellence.

* Hands-on design expertise with power supply topologies (buck, boost, flyback, forward, resonant, PFC, etc.).
* Strong understanding of power supply control schemes, including differences between peak current mode and voltage mode control, with the ability to design appropriate compensation, place poles/zeros, and evaluate converter stability.
* Thorough understanding of EMC/EMI requirements, associated mitigation techniques, and designing power systems to meet regulatory standards.
* Experience in schematic capture and PCB design for power supplies.
* Ability to perform power electronics simulations.
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience across a range of power levels and switching frequencies in DC/DC and AC/DC power conversion.
* Power supply design experience from 10 W to multi-kW.

* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to all audiences.
* Expertise in digital control, complex topologies such as phase-shifted bridge or LLC, and designing protection features (over voltage, undervoltage, overcurrent, etc.).
* Experience selecting appropriate COTS magnetics, with the ability to design custom inductors or transformers when needed.

* Proficient in selecting and integrating key power components with consideration for thermal stress, derating, and overall thermal management.

jobs.title: Software Engineer ? Broadcast Media Platforms
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are seeking a Broadcast Media Systems Software Engineer with a strong focus on data streaming and real-time processing platforms to help design, build, and operate scalable, high-throughput, low-latency systems. This role will work on distributed systems that ingest, process, and deliver streaming data used for analytics, machine learning, monitoring, and mission-critical applications. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability across streaming pipelines.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data streaming pipelines
* Develop and operate transport and broadcast media related architectures
* Implement custom transport logic and socket architectures to handle high-throughput packet and frame-level media streams
* Optimize systems for throughput, latency, and resource efficiency
* Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and metrics for streaming applications
* Integrate and customize open-source media frameworks including FFmpeg, GStreamer, and TSDuck into proprietary streaming ecosystems.
* Implement low-level wrappers and APIs using C, C++, or Rust to interface directly with core networking and hardware-accelerated video codecs.
* Ensure strict stream compliance, packet ordering, fault tolerance, and frame-accurate timing across all linear playout systems.
* Optimize media software for CPU cache locality, minimal memory allocation, zero-copy data paths, and overall resource efficiency.
* Implement robust monitoring, logging, and metrics specifically tailored for packet-level streaming health, jitter, and transport stream analytics.
* Debug production issues related to packet loss, latency spikes, frame corruption, backpressure, or clock drift.
* Support on-call rotations and incident response for critical data systems
* Collaborate with broadcast engineering teams to build, integrate, and test streaming, MAMs, playout, automations, and graphics systems.
* Collaborate with product, analytics, and ML teams to support new use cases
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions
* Contribute to documentation and engineering best practices

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Systems Programming: 2+ years of hands-on experience programming real-time applications at the Low-Level / Packet Level using C, C++, or Rust.
* Must be highly comfortable with manual memory management, pointer manipulation, and multi-threaded optimizations.
* Strong experience in a modern concurrency language like Go or Python for stream orchestration, tooling, and control-plane API development.
* Network Protocols: Deep, foundational understanding of UDP and TCP/IP networking mechanics. Direct experience managing socket programming, custom congestion control, packet pacing, and error correction techniques (ARQ / selective retransmission).
* Media Transport: Proven experience with broadcast and linear video workflows, including media containers and multiplexing (specifically MPEG-TS wrappers).
* Experience building custom stream troubleshooting, diagnostic, or real-time monitoring software.
* Codecs: Codec-agnostic architecture mindset with low-level implementation knowledge of H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, and emerging standards like AV1.
* Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting capabilities in Python or Bash for stream orchestration, pipeline automation, and local-first systems management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct development experience with libsrt, librist, RTMP, or similar APIs.
* Deep familiarity with open-source media frameworks like FFmpeg, Astreamer, GStreamer, TSDuck and low level packet streaming tools.
* Experience using network analysis tools to debug packet loss, jitter, clock drift, and MTU issues on live networks.
* Familiarity with broader broadcast media components, including automation protocols, digital playout systems, on-air graphics engines, and Media Asset Management (MAM) platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure specifically regarding networking components (firewall traversal, listener/caller architecture, and high-bandwidth ingress).
* Lightweight containerization experience or portable streaming endpoints or edge-compute tools.
* Knowledge of serialization formats (like Protobuf or JSON) strictly for control-plane APIs and performance telemetry aggregation.

jobs.description:

===================

13

**The Role:** Director, Software Engineering

  
  

**The Team:** *This role partners with global platform, architecture, governance, security, data mastering, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards. **Responsibilities and Impact:**

  

* **Drive Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery** : Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target enterprise data platform, implementing repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* **Champion AI-Assisted Engineering** : Lead the adoption of AI-powered development tools like Claude, GitHub CoPilot, and LLMs to increase engineering velocity, code quality, and operational effectiveness, while developing context engineering practices and reusable context packs.

* **Influence Semantic Modeling and Data Discoverability** : Support practices to create consistent business definitions, reusable data concepts, and governed consumption patterns, partnering with business, architecture, data governance, and platform teams.

* An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have **10+ years of experience** in data engineering, data platforms, cloud data architecture, software engineering, or related engineering domains.

* Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows, and experience with Databricks-based data platforms and lakehouse-oriented architectures.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs, or similar, and experience applying LLMs to engineering use cases like code generation and optimization.
* We require all external candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
  

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

* Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging, metadata management, business glossary, lineage, operational metadata platforms, or semantic data layers.
* Experience with NeoXam DataHub or NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
* Knowledge of semantic modeling for designing consistent business definitions, improving data discoverability, and supporting governed data consumption.
* **Strong Leadership skills:** including coaching, empowering others to maximize their performance, and working to build consensus across groups with competing priorities.
  

  

**Compensation/Benefits (US Applicants Only):**

  

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $110,000 to $225,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

We're entering a new era defined by the power of AI to transform how organizations operate and innovate. At Microsoft, we're building the next generation of AI-powered platforms and production-grade solutions that help customers solve complex challenges and create meaningful business impact.

Microsoft Frontier Co. is a new line of business and one of the industry's first customer outcome-driven organizations, bringing together industry expertise, strategic partnerships and engineering as part of MCAPS. Its teams will work side-by-side with customers to co-design, deploy, and continuously improve AI systems that deliver measurable, customer-defined outcomes. The organization is built around end-to-end Frontier Transformation, helping customers turn AI into real, lasting business value. For those joining, it's a chance to help build a new growth engine for Microsoft and shape how the industry moves from delivering technology to delivering outcomes.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of advanced technology and real-world customer outcomes. Embedded directly with customers, you'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their most critical challenges and rapidly design, build, and deploy solutions that move from concept to production.

Working in small, cross-functional teams alongside engineers, data scientists, product managers, and domain experts, you'll own the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered production-grade applications, data solutions, and software systems. You'll apply modern engineering practices and AI-enabled engineering practices across the development lifecycle to help customers accelerate decision making, improve operations, and unlock new opportunities.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Partner directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business challenges, define success criteria, and translate needs into technical solutions.

* Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, reliable, and scalable production-grade software systems and services that apply AI and data capabilities where appropriate.

* Rapidly move from concept to prototype to production, iterating alongside customers to deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Build production-quality software that connects customer systems, data, and AI capabilities into reliable end-to-end solutions.

* Drive end-to-end ownership of customer solutions, monitoring performance, reliability, quality, and maintainability, and continuously improving deployed systems after release.

* Collaborate across engineering, data science, product management, design, and customer teams to solve complex technical problems.

* Contribute reusable components, reference implementations, and best practices that can be leveraged across customer engagements.

* Share insights and learnings from customer deployments to help improve Microsoft products, platforms, and engineering practices.

* Foster a culture of learning, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement while contributing to the growth of the broader FDE community.

* Embody our culture and values.

 **Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

* + OR equivalent experience.

* Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role’s job duties.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree (or currently pursuing) in Computer Science or related technical field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

* + OR Master's Degree (or currently pursuing) in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

* + OR equivalent experience.

* Experience through coursework, projects, internships, or employment building software, data, cloud, or AI-enabled solutions.

* Interest in working directly with customers and supporting solutions from early concept through deployment and ongoing improvement.

* Familiarity with AI or machine learning concepts, cloud platforms, data pipelines, application development, or deploying technical solutions.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, learn in ambiguous environments, and communicate clearly.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Azure is building a high-performance and reliable public cloud, and we are seeking talented individuals who can navigate the full technology stack—from hardware to systems to applications—turning ideas into production systems rapidly. Join us as a Hardware Engineer to create the world's fastest public cloud and make a difference to millions worldwide.

As a Senior Hardware Engineer on the Azure Boost Storage Acceleration Hardware team, you will be responsible for micro-architecture and hardware module design, timing closure, rigorous verification and testing of hardware systems, and deploying accelerated storage services. You will drive the next generation of accelerated storage through hardware-first protocols like Non-Volatile Memory Express (NVMe), optimizing design to enhance IO per second (IOPS), bandwidth, latency, and overhead. This role offers the unique opportunity for rapid hardware development, allowing concepts to reach production within months instead of years. Join us to shape the future of cloud storage in one of the world's truly hyperscale global clouds, with innovation opportunities spanning the entire computing stack.  
  
This position provides a unique chance for hardware developers to see their RTL code go to production within weeks, and for software developers to harness the performance and efficiency of customized hardware. Help us build one of the few truly hyperscale global clouds, with innovations possible at every level of the computing stack.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help develop the next-generation of Apple’s cloud services infrastructure. You will be working on CloudKit, Apple’s foundational privacy-focused database platform, which securely stores users’ data and seamlessly keeps it synchronized across all their Apple devices.  
  
**Description**  
  
CloudKit manages data at a massive scale! It is a strongly-consistent database of structured data that serves billions of active Apple customers. Considered the bedrock of iCloud, it is purpose built to be performant, highly available, and extremely scalable. CloudKit is a framework designed to the highest standards of user privacy that not only empowers developers to build highly collaborative and secure applications but is also the storage foundation for Apple’s signature cloud experiences, such as Photos, Drive, Notes, Keynote, News, and many third-party applications!  
  
We are a world-class team who has a real passion for engineering and delivering high quality services to Apple’s customers. As a key member of a versatile organization, you will introduce new fundamental capabilities that will help power entirely new applications and scale existing ones.  
  
We are looking for engineers who have exceptional expertise in building fault-tolerant distributed systems. jobs.description:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As a Project Software Engineer II on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.  
  
You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

* Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
* Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
* Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
* Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
* Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

* Effective written and verbal communication skills

* Ability to meet deadlines

* 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns

* 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Verustruct is developing a suite of robotic construction technologies to automate the building of affordable, sustainable, safe, and aesthetically appealing housing. The company’s mission is to help close the U.S. housing gap of 4.5 million homes by transforming how residential structures are designed and built. Verustruct focuses on integrating advanced robotics, automation, and novel construction methods into practical, scalable solutions. Team members collaborate across disciplines to bring next-generation construction systems from concept to field deployment, with a strong emphasis on real-world impact and long-term sustainability.

**About the Role**

Build the electrical systems that turn robotic construction devices into reliable, autonomous machines.

Verustruct is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer to own electrical architecture and subsystem development for our robotic construction platform. You will take systems from requirements and circuit design through board bring-up, embedded integration, machine testing, and field deployment.

Our robots combine motors, actuators, sensors, embedded controllers, and construction processes in a demanding physical environment. You will make those systems operate predictably together, with particular attention to power integrity, communications, fault handling, serviceability, and safe machine behavior.

This is a hands-on technical ownership role with opportunities to mentor engineers and shape the electrical team’s standards as we grow. It is full-time and on-site in Torrance, California.

**What You'll Do**

* Define electrical architectures, subsystem requirements, power budgets, and interfaces across robotic formwork, locomotion, material delivery, consolidation, and auxiliary tools.
* Own custom electronics from component selection and schematic capture through PCB layout, fabrication, assembly, bring-up, and revision.
* Develop power-distribution, motor-control, actuator-interface, and sensor-interface hardware, including appropriate protection, grounding, shielding, and thermal management.
* Write, review, and debug embedded C/C++ on STM32-class microcontrollers for sensing, actuator control, communications, diagnostics, and fault handling.
* Define and validate CAN/CAN FD network architecture, including physical topology, termination, message interfaces, bus loading, and recovery behavior.
* Design harnesses, connector interfaces, electrical enclosures, and service features for equipment exposed to vibration, dust, moisture, and electrically noisy loads.
* Partner with controls and software engineers to define timing requirements, operating states, watchdog behavior, and responses to communication or component failures.
* Develop emergency-stop, interlock, and power-isolation architectures in coordination with system safety requirements and the broader engineering team.
* Create verification plans, test fixtures, and automated tests that demonstrate electrical performance and fault response at board, subsystem, and machine levels.
* Lead electrical integration and root-cause investigation, using measured evidence to resolve intermittent and cross-disciplinary failures.
* Own electrical release documentation and design reviews, support suppliers and manufacturing partners, and mentor junior engineers.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What We're Looking For**

* Substantial electrical product-development experience, typically 7+ years, with ownership of complex electromechanical systems.
* Demonstrated delivery of custom electronics from design through working hardware and integrated system testing.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics, power conversion and distribution, motor drives, signal integrity, and circuit protection.
* Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB design using KiCad, Altium, or comparable tools.
* Practical embedded C/C++ experience and the ability to debug hardware and firmware together.
* Experience integrating motors, actuators, encoders, sensors, and communications such as CAN, SPI, I2C, and UART.
* Strong bench skills with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, electronic loads, and other electrical test equipment.
* Experience with harness design, grounding, shielding, and troubleshooting noise or power-related failures in operating machines.
* Clear technical communication, sound design-review judgment, and a willingness to work directly on prototype hardware.
* A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Benefits**
------------

Benefits include:

* **Health insurance:** Silver PPO plan, 80% company-paid, with optional dental and vision coverage
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with 4% employer match
* **Time off:** Flexible PTO policy and observed federal holidays
* **Relocation support:** Available for exceptional candidates relocating to the Los Angeles / Torrance area
* **High-ownership role:** Opportunity to help lead mechanical engineering for a venture-backed robotics company tackling housing affordability

Compensation Range: $160K - $205K

You'll apply your expertise in computer system architecture, circuit design, power delivery, high-speed interfaces, and PCB design to solve some of the industry's most challenging system integration problems-all while maximizing performance, battery life, reliability, and user experience within one of the world's most space-constrained consumer products.  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are excited by solving complex engineering challenges that impact millions of users, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
**Description**  
  
Day-to-day responsibilities include designing robust electrical subsystems and owning schematic design, simulation, debugging, and validation. As the Design Responsible Individual (DRI) for your subsystem, you will present design proposals and tradeoffs to cross-functional partners, drive technical discussions, and build alignment through design reviews. You will own your subsystem through mass production, partnering with manufacturing and operations to  
  
support factory builds, resolve line-down issues, investigate manufacturing issues and yield excursions, and implement design improvements that enhance product quality, manufacturability, and production efficiency.  
  
We are looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, broad system knowledge, sound engineering judgment, and the curiosity to dive deep and solve difficult problems wherever they arise.  
  
There will be opportunities for international travel.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with industry-level practical experience.  
  
Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, including analog and digital circuit theory, signal integrity, and power integrity.  
  
Experience in circuit design in one or more areas, including power, digital, analog, high-speed interfaces, programmable logic, or wireless systems.  
  
Strong PCB layout expertise spanning constrained multilayer designs, high-speed interfaces, power delivery networks, flex circuits, and cable assemblies. Proficiency with Allegro or equivalent PCB design tools.  
  
Experience with electrical validation and debug using high-speed oscilloscopes, vector network analyzers, BERTs, and protocol analyzers.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Solid understanding of the design, validation, and debug requirements for common interfaces (e.g., I2C, SPI, JTAG, I2S) and high-speed interfaces (e.g., USB, PCIe, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt, DDR).  
  
Experience with schematic capture and constraint-driven PCB design using Cadence Allegro/OrCAD or equivalent EDA tools.  
  
Experience with numerical modeling, simulation, and analysis tools, including SPICE, 2D/3D field solvers, and power and signal integrity analysis.  
  
Experience with data analysis, visualization, and scripting to automate validation, debug, and engineering workflows.  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.  
  
Intellectually curious, creative, collaborative, and passionate about solving challenging engineering problems and continuously learning.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $129,300 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

Overview:

At The Marzetti Company, our mission is to make every meal better through high-quality, flavorful food. The Automation & Controls Engineer is a hands-on technical resource responsible for the reliability, improvement, integration, and cybersecurity of automation systems across food processing, packaging, plant utilities, and facility infrastructure.

Working with a high degree of independence, this role supports day-to-day production, resolves complex controls issues, modernizes legacy systems, and delivers automation projects that improve safety, food quality, throughput, equipment uptime, and the operator experience. The engineer partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality and Food Safety, Continuous Improvement, Information Technology, and external OEMs and system integrators.

Technology Environment:

* **PLC and machine control:** Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation ControlLogix and CompactLogix using Studio 5000; additional platforms may include ABB, Bosch Rexroth, Mitsubishi, Omron, and Siemens.
* **Visualization and manufacturing systems:** Ignition SCADA and historian capabilities, FactoryTalk View, ThinManager, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
* **Connectivity and data:** EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, Profibus, IO-Link, Microsoft SQL Server, database interfaces, and Python scripting.
* **OT infrastructure:** Managed industrial switches, VLANs, segmented OT networks, firewall rules, Claroty xDome Secure Access for secure remote access, role-based access control, and Purdue Model/five-layer OT architecture.

* Implement and maintain role-based access, least-privilege permissions, user groups, and account governance across PLC, SCADA, ThinManager, historian, MES, server, and network environments.
* Integrate OEM equipment, sensors, PLCs, SCADA, MES, historians, databases, and enterprise systems using EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT, serial or gateway communications, and other appropriate protocols.
* Support MQTT and edge-connectivity solutions, including broker connectivity, topic or namespace design, reliable data transfer, and plant-floor-to-enterprise integration.
* Configure and support Microsoft SQL Server connections, tables, queries, views, and data flows; develop Python scripts for data collection, diagnostics, reporting, configuration, and repetitive engineering tasks.

**Reliability, Operational Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide responsive technical support to Maintenance and Operations, taking ownership of control-system problems through containment, diagnosis, corrective action, and verified resolution.

Molex is offering a highly visible role for a Signal Integrity Systems Engineer, and you will design leading-edge solutions for the data services industry, influence next-generation active cable platforms using innovative chips in coordination with engineers from various disciplines.

With operations in more than 40 countries, Molex offers connectivity products, services, and solutions for the data communications, medical, industrial, automotive, and consumer electronics industries. We do more than develop customer solutions-we create connections for life.

Molex is looking for a Signal Integrity Systems Engineer to support and develop Active cable designs for Hyperscalers. Our business is witnessing tremendous growth owing to an increasing need for Artificial Intelligence and data transfer rates. You will be working under leadership that has been setting and driving industry standards in data centers for more than 30 years.

* Own system-level SI analysis for high-speed channels including AEC, ACC, DAC, connectors, and PCB interconnects.

* Experience in high-speed signal integrity, channel modeling, or system validation.

* Experience with HFSS, Keysight ADS/PLTS, Cadence Sigrity, or similar tools.

* Hands-on experience with VNA, TDR/TDT, high-speed oscilloscopes, and BERTs.

* Experience with AEC/ACC/DAC cables and high-speed connectors.
* Experience with IBIS-AMI modeling and simulation.
* Understanding of IEEE, OIF, and/or relevant industry specifications.
* Experience with CMIS, QSFP, OSFP, or other pluggable optical/electrical interfaces.
* Experience correlating simulation models with physical measurements.
* Experience with automated SI data processing using Python.

You’ll join a collaborative team building state‑of‑the‑art power electronics—closed‑loop power supplies, EMI filters, high‑efficiency conversion stages—and guide designs from concept through qualification. This hands‑on role spans power conversion systems, magnetics, EMI mitigation, and PFC solutions, offering opportunities to innovate at every stage of the hardware lifecycle.

* Fort Wayne, IN

* Generate engineering documentation: requirements, design descriptions, schematics, BOMs, and test plans.
* Support integration, verification, validation, and qualification testing new and existing designs.
* Partner closely with Systems, Mechanical, Software, Manufacturing and Digital Hardware teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Diagnose and solve issues related to power conversion performance, reliability, EMI/EMC, and thermal behavior.
* Ensure adherence to aerospace standards and mission assurance expectations.
* Mentor junior engineers and support a culture of technical excellence.

* Hands-on design expertise with power supply topologies (buck, boost, flyback, forward, resonant, PFC, etc.).
* Strong understanding of power supply control schemes, including differences between peak current mode and voltage mode control, with the ability to design appropriate compensation, place poles/zeros, and evaluate converter stability.
* Thorough understanding of EMC/EMI requirements, associated mitigation techniques, and designing power systems to meet regulatory standards.
* Experience in schematic capture and PCB design for power supplies.
* Ability to perform power electronics simulations.
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience across a range of power levels and switching frequencies in DC/DC and AC/DC power conversion.
* Power supply design experience from 10 W to multi-kW.

* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to all audiences.
* Expertise in digital control, complex topologies such as phase-shifted bridge or LLC, and designing protection features (over voltage, undervoltage, overcurrent, etc.).
* Experience selecting appropriate COTS magnetics, with the ability to design custom inductors or transformers when needed.

* Proficient in selecting and integrating key power components with consideration for thermal stress, derating, and overall thermal management.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Broadcast Media Systems Software Engineer with a strong focus on data streaming and real-time processing platforms to help design, build, and operate scalable, high-throughput, low-latency systems. This role will work on distributed systems that ingest, process, and deliver streaming data used for analytics, machine learning, monitoring, and mission-critical applications. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability across streaming pipelines.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data streaming pipelines
* Develop and operate transport and broadcast media related architectures
* Implement custom transport logic and socket architectures to handle high-throughput packet and frame-level media streams
* Optimize systems for throughput, latency, and resource efficiency
* Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and metrics for streaming applications
* Integrate and customize open-source media frameworks including FFmpeg, GStreamer, and TSDuck into proprietary streaming ecosystems.
* Implement low-level wrappers and APIs using C, C++, or Rust to interface directly with core networking and hardware-accelerated video codecs.
* Ensure strict stream compliance, packet ordering, fault tolerance, and frame-accurate timing across all linear playout systems.
* Optimize media software for CPU cache locality, minimal memory allocation, zero-copy data paths, and overall resource efficiency.
* Implement robust monitoring, logging, and metrics specifically tailored for packet-level streaming health, jitter, and transport stream analytics.
* Debug production issues related to packet loss, latency spikes, frame corruption, backpressure, or clock drift.
* Support on-call rotations and incident response for critical data systems
* Collaborate with broadcast engineering teams to build, integrate, and test streaming, MAMs, playout, automations, and graphics systems.
* Collaborate with product, analytics, and ML teams to support new use cases
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions
* Contribute to documentation and engineering best practices

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Systems Programming: 2+ years of hands-on experience programming real-time applications at the Low-Level / Packet Level using C, C++, or Rust.
* Must be highly comfortable with manual memory management, pointer manipulation, and multi-threaded optimizations.
* Strong experience in a modern concurrency language like Go or Python for stream orchestration, tooling, and control-plane API development.
* Network Protocols: Deep, foundational understanding of UDP and TCP/IP networking mechanics. Direct experience managing socket programming, custom congestion control, packet pacing, and error correction techniques (ARQ / selective retransmission).
* Media Transport: Proven experience with broadcast and linear video workflows, including media containers and multiplexing (specifically MPEG-TS wrappers).
* Experience building custom stream troubleshooting, diagnostic, or real-time monitoring software.
* Codecs: Codec-agnostic architecture mindset with low-level implementation knowledge of H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, and emerging standards like AV1.
* Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting capabilities in Python or Bash for stream orchestration, pipeline automation, and local-first systems management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct development experience with libsrt, librist, RTMP, or similar APIs.
* Deep familiarity with open-source media frameworks like FFmpeg, Astreamer, GStreamer, TSDuck and low level packet streaming tools.
* Experience using network analysis tools to debug packet loss, jitter, clock drift, and MTU issues on live networks.
* Familiarity with broader broadcast media components, including automation protocols, digital playout systems, on-air graphics engines, and Media Asset Management (MAM) platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure specifically regarding networking components (firewall traversal, listener/caller architecture, and high-bandwidth ingress).
* Lightweight containerization experience or portable streaming endpoints or edge-compute tools.
* Knowledge of serialization formats (like Protobuf or JSON) strictly for control-plane APIs and performance telemetry aggregation.

**Overview**

We're entering a new era defined by the power of AI to transform how organizations operate and innovate. At Microsoft, we're building the next generation of AI-powered platforms and production-grade solutions that help customers solve complex challenges and create meaningful business impact.

Microsoft Frontier Co. is a new line of business and one of the industry's first customer outcome-driven organizations, bringing together industry expertise, strategic partnerships and engineering as part of MCAPS. Its teams will work side-by-side with customers to co-design, deploy, and continuously improve AI systems that deliver measurable, customer-defined outcomes. The organization is built around end-to-end Frontier Transformation, helping customers turn AI into real, lasting business value. For those joining, it's a chance to help build a new growth engine for Microsoft and shape how the industry moves from delivering technology to delivering outcomes.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of advanced technology and real-world customer outcomes. Embedded directly with customers, you'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their most critical challenges and rapidly design, build, and deploy solutions that move from concept to production.

Working in small, cross-functional teams alongside engineers, data scientists, product managers, and domain experts, you'll own the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered production-grade applications, data solutions, and software systems. You'll apply modern engineering practices and AI-enabled engineering practices across the development lifecycle to help customers accelerate decision making, improve operations, and unlock new opportunities.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Partner directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business challenges, define success criteria, and translate needs into technical solutions.

* Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, reliable, and scalable production-grade software systems and services that apply AI and data capabilities where appropriate.

* Rapidly move from concept to prototype to production, iterating alongside customers to deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Foster a culture of learning, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement while contributing to the growth of the broader FDE community.

* Embody our culture and values.

* + OR Master's Degree (or currently pursuing) in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

* + OR equivalent experience.

Microsoft Azure is building a high-performance and reliable public cloud, and we are seeking talented individuals who can navigate the full technology stack—from hardware to systems to applications—turning ideas into production systems rapidly. You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.  
  
**Key Responsibilities** :  

* Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
* Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
* Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
* Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
* Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales  

  
  
**A successful candidate would possess** :  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  

  
  
**The Team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  
  
Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.  
  
The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
* Active Top Secret clearance
* 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure.
* 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
* 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO).
* 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment.

  
Preferred:  

* 2+ years of experience with identity verification, biometric, or credentialing systems
* 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns
* 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
* 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Security Specialty)
